integrationHistory: Nine-lane fan-out: H4.7 recovery/chaos, H7.4 reconciler, H9.3 listing lifecycle, H9.4 universe view, H7.3 alpaca options + capability matrix, TH2.1 hypothesis validation, TH2.2 discovery, TH2.3 RCA revision loop, TH2.4 statistical discipline.
Two lanes (T109, T163) failed silently on first dispatch and were re-run; T124's first attempt left partial files that the retry assessed and completed.

Key integration findings recorded: T134 delivered the on_corporate_action contract hook with engine wiring points documented (engine.py:354-361 poll-deliver, binding.py dispatch, portfolio listing_lifecycle composition point for settlement; rename needs a VirtualBook.migrate_symbol seam that does not exist yet); T135 pinned subscription boundary semantics (next-event delivery, no determinism violation); T162's local ledger interfaces have a documented mechanical adapter onto thesis.experiments.ledger (needs an exploratory no-contract mode decision); T163 established workflows -> research -> experiments dependency direction.
limitations: Corporate-action engine dispatch (deriver construction, settlement composition, order cancellation before delivery) is documented but not yet wired into engine.py — a T134 follow-up owns the wiring.
Rename continuity requires a VirtualBook.migrate_symbol seam (portfolio-owned) before rename events can preserve cost basis through the engine path.
Discovery accounting uses local ledger interfaces pending the exploratory-mode adapter onto thesis.experiments.ledger.
